# Re-use {.phase-reuse}

```{=html}
<div class="model-signs" aria-label="Where this sits in the PFTC model">
<span class="sign sign-reuse">Re-use</span>
</div>
<div class="phase-rule phase-reuse"></div>
```

Re-use is the last block of the PFTC toolbox.
It has one step: **Find & reuse**.
That means locating a published PFTC dataset and using it again, with the citation the data paper asks for.

The datasets, papers, and download notes are in [Working with PFTC data](6_pftc_data.qmd).
